hints.title: Overwrite Precedence
hints.text: Later queries overwrite earlier queries on the same row or column.

hints.title: Reverse Chronological Scan
hints.text: Process queries backward from the end to the beginning.

hints.title: Remaining Unfilled Cells
hints.text: Each newly encountered row fills cells minus the number of already filled columns.

hints.title: Backward Query Reduction

complexity.notes: Reverse pass processes each query in O(1) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Updating the n x n matrix directly for each query takes O(q * n) time, exceeding time limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash sets track seen rows and columns efficiently.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Processes queries in reverse order to resolve overwrites immediately.
